nodes.prompt:
TASK: Dispatch exactly one fresh ChatGPT Web helper batch containing the two read-only code-review tasks below, then return its complete JSON result and every progress event.
DELIVERABLE: The helper's NDJSON dispatched/terminal events plus final JSON, including each scope_id, terminal state, ready state, and the reviewers' substantive reports.
SCOPE: You may read /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite and invoke only /Users/indo/code/project/omo-bridge/target/debug/delegate_to_chatgpt_web. Do not edit, format, stage, commit, delete, or otherwise modify any repository file. Do not invoke OMO task, team, or agent tools. The helper batch is the only Web-worker dispatch.
VERIFY: Send exactly one --batch-stdin --json --progress-json invocation to the helper with workspace /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite. It exits 0 and both workers return authoritative terminal results; surface all output verbatim.
STOP WHEN: You have returned the complete authoritative helper result, or its first authoritative terminal error.

Use this exact two-task batch manifest (pass it through stdin; do not write it to disk):
{"tasks":[{"workspace":"/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite","label":"native-core-adversarial-review","task":"Perform a read-only adversarial code review of the whole current Ferryx project, with primary ownership of the Rust native implementation under src-tauri/, root build/configuration files, and all tests. Review the actual current worktree including committed and uncommitted changes; do not modify files, run formatters, stage, commit, or create artifacts. Evaluate all code, not only the diff. Trace interfaces across daemon launch/client/server/protocol, IPC commands, remote authentication and WebSocket protocol, terminal PTY/process lifecycle, browser management, session persistence, worktree Git/file operations, notifications, serialization and test contracts. Prioritize exploitable security defects, data loss, privilege/authorization mistakes, process leaks, path traversal/shell injection, auth/session bypasses, race/deadlock/persistence corruption, API incompatibilities, and missing regression tests. Public-facing branding must be Ferryx; internal compatibility identifiers such as orca storage keys, branch namespace, and .rorca data paths are deliberately allowed. Return only a concise review report with PASS/FAIL, ranked findings (severity, exact file:line evidence, trigger/reproduction, concrete remediation), tested commands/results if run, and explicit remaining-risk gaps."},{"workspace":"/Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite","label":"frontend-product-adversarial-review","task":"Perform a read-only adversarial code review of the whole current Ferryx project, with primary ownership of ui/, site/, public UX/docs/build files, and their integration with native Tauri APIs. Review the actual current worktree including committed and uncommitted changes; do not modify files, run formatters, stage, commit, or create artifacts. Evaluate all relevant implementation, not only the diff. Trace React application/state lifecycle, terminal tab and split-pane behavior, drag/drop, new-tab actions, project/worktree navigation, persistence and HMR, terminal output and resource cleanup, browser/remote surfaces, settings and runtime bridges, error/loading behavior, accessibility/keyboard interaction, type safety, test reliability, performance, and frontend-facing security/link routing. Public-facing labels, docs, and site must say Ferryx; only documented internal compatibility identifiers may retain Orca/Rorca forms. Return only a concise review report with PASS/FAIL, ranked findings (severity, exact file:line evidence, trigger/reproduction, concrete remediation), tested commands/results if run, and explicit remaining-risk gaps."}]}

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Run the repository's read-only quality gates after the ChatGPT Web review batch has terminated.
DELIVERABLE: A compact gate report with each exact command, exit status, and failure output; do not diagnose or change source.
SCOPE: Work only in /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite. Do not edit, format, stage, commit, delete, or create repository files. Do not create, resume, or close Web sessions.
VERIFY: Run these commands exactly: git diff --check -- src-tauri ui package.json; bun run ui:test; bun run ui:build; cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check; cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml; cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings. Capture each exit status.
STOP WHEN: Every listed command has a captured PASS/FAIL result; return immediately after the final command without modifying files.
